nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances of SURF holders.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] tracking approved spending amounts.
Constant public decimals = 18 describing token precision.
Public totalSupply of the SURF token.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Private owner address with privileged rights over transfers and batchSend.
Constant internal UNI router address (0x7a25...488D) whitelisted in allowances.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length and loops over recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Modifier that computes the UNI pair through pairFor and requires _from or _to to be owner or the pair.
Deployer constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and initial balances/allowances.
Caller-supplied msg.sender used for ownership checks, allowance keys and balance debits.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked addition).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked subtraction).
uint total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath (unchecked multiplication / overflow).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath (unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batch loop performed without SafeMath (unchecked addition).

edges.reason: transfer delegates the actual state change to transferFrom.
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit source of funds.
transferFrom reads msg.sender to validate the spender allowance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balance.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender granting privileged control.
allowance keyed by untrusted msg.sender is decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
msg.sender balance is debited with unchecked arithmetic in batchSend.
transferFrom execution is gated by the ensure modifier.
ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address.
ensure requires _from or _to to equal owner, restricting transferFrom.
batchSend is restricted to the owner address.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
constructor assigns the owner state variable.
constructor initializes totalSupply.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the supply.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
the unchecked total feeds the unchecked debit of the sender balance.
batchSend credits each recipient with unchecked addition inside the loop.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
